verdict.rationale: Elicit supports importing/uploading papers (via browser extension fetching PDFs, Zotero import, Systematic Reviews paper gathering) and lets users create data-extraction columns pulling from body text of uploaded papers, and the Research Agent can reason across sources in a session. However, there's no clear documented flow for uploading an arbitrary personal PDF corpus and having the general Research Agent (outside Systematic Reviews) freely research over just that private corpus, and community feedback raises accuracy/hallucination concerns on paper-based tasks. missing for 10: explicit bulk PDF upload/corpus ingestion API for arbitrary files, confirmation the Research Agent (not just Systematic Review data extraction) can scope its reasoning strictly to user-uploaded documents, and independent verification of accuracy on uploaded corpora.
